column3: NKJV begins with “And,” following the Textus Receptus; in the critical text “already” of verse 35 may begin this verse.
NKJV includes “the Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the Savior of the world.”
NKJV has “and went,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “He went out from there into Galilee.”
Close to the Greek; “royal official” is rendered “nobleman.”
NKJV has “Your son lives,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “that his child was living.”
